senses.gloss:
मु मु, उस्, m. (fr. rt. 1. मू, q. v.), a bond,
binding, confinement; an epithet of Śiva; final
emancipation; a funeral pile; a reddish brown or
tawny colour.

मू 1. मू (connected with rts. मव्,
मव्य्), cl. 1. A. मवते (sometimes P. -ति),
to bind, tie, make fast: Caus. Aor. अमीमवत्:
Desid. of Caus. मिमावयिषति, see Scholist on Pāṇ.
VII. 4, 80.
